text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Eco Majestic) 2016.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 19 Oktober 2016.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Eco

Majestic yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Kajang-Seremban bermula di

kilometer 10.47 di koordinaat U 320698.462, T 425685.098 Grid Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 11.11

di koordinat U 320054.254, T 425697.390 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) Lebuh Raya

Kajang-Seremban, kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya

Kajang-Seremban termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Kajang Selatan, Plaza Tol

Masuk/Keluar Kajang Selatan, Persimpangan Bertingkat Semenyih, Plaza Tol

Masuk/Keluar Semenyih, Persimpangan Bertingkat Eco Majestic, Plaza Tol

Masuk/Keluar Eco Majestic, Persimpangan Bertingkat Pajam, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar

Pajam, Persimpangan Bertingkat Mantin, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Mantin, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Setul, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Setul, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Ampangan,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Jelebu, Persimpangan Bertingkat Paroi dan jalan-jalan

sambungannya yang berakhir di koordinat U 320339.721, T 426768.025 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (ECO MAJESTIC INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the

Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State

Government of Selangor, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Eco Majestic

Interchange) Order 2016.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 19 October 2016.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Eco Majestic Interchange which is part

of the Kajang-Seremban Highway commencing at kilometre 10.47 at coordinates

N 320698.462, E 425685.098 of Rectified Skew Orhtomorphic (RSO) Geocentic (GDM

2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 11.11 at coordinates N 320054.254, E 425697.390

of RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid of the Kajang-Seremban Highway, both distances

measured from kilometre 0.0 at Kajang-Seremban Highway including Kajang Selatan

Interchange, Kajang Selatan Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Semenyih Interchange, Semenyih

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Eco Majestic Interchange, Eco Majestic Entry/Exit Toll Plaza,

Pajam Interchange, Pajam Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Mantin Interchange, Mantin

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Setul Interchange, Setul Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Ampangan

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Jelebu Interchange, Paroi Interchange and its link road and

ending at coordinates N 320339.721, E 426768.025 of RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000)

Grid, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
